name: zinterp_context_command_equals_prefix
description: zInterp_Context::CommandEqualsPrefix compares tokenList[0] against a fixed prefix length.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Original assembly passes a null command pointer to strncmp when tokenCount is zero; callers normally gate command dispatch before using this helper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c5480 validates reading tokenCount at context offset 0x08, selecting tokenList[0] at offset 0x20 when tokenCount is nonzero, calling strncmp(command, prefix, prefixLen), and returning one only when the comparison result is zero.
The native smoke verifies matching and nonmatching command prefixes against tokenList[0].
